name: The Dark Stair

side.hint: Stick walks, A jumps. Slabs glide, planks give way. A fall sets you back on firm ground.

hints: The Dark Stair is done. The ring of light on the balcony leads back up. The Answer waits in the cathedral.
Wren is with you. Press A again in the air for a second jump: the shelf past the high block is in reach.
Tap A to jump. Slabs glide, planks give way. B looks at what was left behind.

up: The stair climbs back to the door under the bluff.
niche: A lamp niche, cut low in the wall. You have to stoop to see into it.
Inside, a row of little scratches. Someone small was counting something.
rope: A coil of rope, and a harness of leather straps. The harness would fit around your forearm.
The rope has been let out and hauled in so often that it has worn a groove in the stone.
oil: A sack of lamp-oil flasks, each the size of a thumb. Small flasks, for a small carrier.
Chalked on the wall above it, in a grown hand: FURTHER TODAY, WREN. THE ANSWER SEES YOU.

case: The carved feather is dark. The tin cup has not moved.
That is my cup. You can leave it. I do not get thirsty now.
A feather is carved into the stone, lit from within. Beside it stand a tin cup and a paper feather gone brown.
The stone is warm. Someone is holding the other side of it.
Are you the one who comes to pull the rope?
I asked not to go down any more. It gave me this, so I could jump the gaps. So they sent me further.
I cannot get back up from here. I have been trying the whole time.
Wren's echo joins you. You learned the Second Jump: press A again in the air.
The strongbox is empty. The ledger lies where you left it.

then: The wardens' strongbox sits under its two dead lamps.
else: A strongbox sits by the wall, under two dead lamps on poles.
As you reach for it, the lamps light.

then: Inside are three Tonics, and a ledger in a neat hand.
A column of dates. Beside each date, a depth.
The last line has a depth, and no date after it.
They carried me the first part. They were nice about it.

ring: A ring of pale light is set in the floor.
